## Summary

**TEX** (Texture, sizeable without modular): Gets a byte from array An (texture) from position Ax,Ay.

The original shows the title of one of these pages grayed out; see the variants below.

## Details

### Variant 1: Texture, sizeable without modular

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `(An,Ax.h,Ay.h*Dm) → Dn` |
| Syntax | `TEX (An,Ax,Ay*Dm),Dn` |
| Short | Gets a byte from array An (texture) from position Ax,Ay |
| Description | Usefull for 8bit texture or screen color lookup. Get byte Dn from texture or screen An that has a linewidth of Dm at position Ax,Ay. Ax & Ay are seen as 16bit integer 16 bit fraction longs. Only the 16bit integer part is used. REX sets a byte in an array. TEX reads a byte from an array Size byte. This TEX can have any mapsize, but there is no checking if Ax & Ay are in the map. (modulo) |
| Condition codes | not affected |

#### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–8 | `11111110` |
| 1 | 7 | Dm |
| 1 | 6 | Dn |
| 1 | 5–3 | `110` |
| 1 | 2–0 | An |
| 2 | 15–12 | Dm |
| 2 | 11–8 | Dn |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00111110` |
| 3 | 15 | `1` |
| 3 | 14–12 | Ay |
| 3 | 11–3 | `000000001` |
| 3 | 2–0 | Ax |

- Texture size: use multiplier Dm.

#### Notes

- This TEX is supported from core 12540
- B-registers are not allowed. Not a vector operation.

### Variant 2: Texture (title grayed out in the original)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `(An,(Av,Au) → d` |
| Syntax | `TEX8.512 (An,(Av,Au)),Dn`<br>`TEX16.256 (An,(Av,Au)),Dn`<br>`TEX24.64 (An,(Av,Au))*D0,Dn` |
| Short | Gets from picture array An ( position Au,Av ) a byte,word or 3byte. |
| Description | Gets a color from a texture position u,v. shifts the destination up and inserts the color there. An points to the texture. Au & Av are 16bit integer 16 bit fraction longs. Au & Av are seen as modular, so always point inside the map. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

#### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–3 | `1111111000110` |
| 1 | 2–0 | An |
| 2 | 15 | `0` |
| 2 | 14–12 | Au |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00111110` |
| 3 | 15 | `1` |
| 3 | 14–12 | Av |
| 3 | 11 | `1` |
| 3 | 10–9 | S |
| 3 | 8 | `0` |
| 3 | 7 | S |
| 3 | 6–4 | T |
| 3 | 3–2 | `00` |
| 3 | 1–0 | S |

- S size destination:
- 8 byte 00 0 00
- 16 word 01 0 01
- 24 24bit 11 1 10 \*
- Texture size
- 64 x 64 000
- 128 x 128 011
- 256 x 256 101
- 512 x 512 110
- \* The texture for 24bit must be nvidia dxt1 compressed.

```text
   This is also the case for Maggie rendering.
```

#### Notes

- The thirth word seem to be a specialized brief extension word.
- Tex is fully supported by sa core 7.4 but seem to be broken in current cores
- but tex8.256 & tex16.256 are working. (up to 10500 confirmed)
- Vasm use “tex a0,a1,a2,#imm,d3” (#imm seem not to work)
- Asm1 use “tex8.256 (a0,(a1,a2)),d3” or “tex8.256 (a0(a1,a2)),d3” or vasm

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no TEX. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use B registers with TEX (An,Ax,Ay*Dm),Dn; it needs core 12540 or later.
- DON'T rely on the TEX8.512/TEX16.256/TEX24.64 form beyond tex8.256 and tex16.256: the manual says it seems broken in current cores.
